cohort: 100 infants less than eight weeks old who were hospitalized due to jaundice in the neonatal ward of Amiralmomenin Ali (AS) Hospital in Zabol
finding: The rate of urinary tract infection in newborns with prolonged jaundice is more prevalent in comparison with healthy infants.
